subject: Automatically update app without having to type Y in the R console

messages.author: 6cdeddea74c1d638
messages.subject: Automatically update app without having to type Y in the R console
parts:
I'm trying to schedule a shiny app that needs to get re-uploaded once a day. The problem is that I have to manually type Y because the following prompt comes up:

Update application currently deployed at
####myshinyapp#####? [Y/n]

I would like to not have this come up but I can't seem to figure out a way to override it. 

Stackoverflow had one solution where it mentioned that simply putting Y after deployApp() would work, but that only works if you highlight the program, not if it runs on its own.
